$comment: The parts of the candidate profile the site's JSON does not model, but the job-search framework needs. Kept here so data/ stays the single source of truth for both projects — scripts/build-profile-md.mjs folds this into .claude/skills/job-application-assistant/01-candidate-profile.md. Leave a field empty and the generated profile says so plainly rather than inventing one.

languages.notes: Every language you can work in professionally, with your honest level. The Language Gate in 04-job-evaluation.md treats an undeclared language as a hard no, so omit what you do not actually work in.
